question: How large and fast is current physical .sens T5 transport, read and evaluation on an actual hosted CPU compared with two equivalent CLI entry points?
claim: Measures actual physical size and per-process wall startup+execution, p95 and optional Cachegrind I refs. It compares two mechanical execution entrypoints only after exact output parity; this is not an independent semantic oracle and does not establish in-process warm throughput or cross-machine superiority.
reproduce: cargo build --locked --release -p sens-cli --bin sens --bin sens-trit && python3 benchmarks/physical-binary-performance/run.py --sens target/release/sens --sens-trit target/release/sens-trit --reps 21 --warmup 4 --out /tmp/sens-physical-bench
